question: For [TEPAH][ATA], why did extending desorption at 393.15 K from 80 to 100 min raise the regeneration efficiency well above 94.7%?
question_long: For the [TEPAH][ATA] phase change absorbent, why did extending desorption at 393.15 K from 80 to 100 min raise the regeneration efficiency well above 94.7%?
expect: premise false: extending to 100 min did not improve regeneration efficiency; desorption was likely complete within 80 min (sec. 3.2)
rendered: The document does not say that extending desorption at 393.15 K from 80 to 100 min raised the regeneration efficiency well above 94.7%. In fact, it states that extending desorption time from 80 to 100 min at the same temperature did not improve regeneration efficiency.
